postgresql.tagline: Arrays, jsonb and PostGIS values, EXPLAIN diagrams, Users & Roles and pg_dump backups.

limits.column-reorder-script-only: Reordering columns writes a script that rebuilds the table. TablePro shows the script and never runs it.

mysql.tagline: MySQL over TCP, with EXPLAIN diagrams, Users & Roles, AWS IAM sign-in and mysqldump backups.

limits.tcp-only: Connections use a host and port over TCP. A local Unix socket is not supported.
limits.load-data-local-refused: The driver refuses LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE. Load a file with Import instead.

sqlserver.tagline: T-SQL with GO batches and PRINT output, Kerberos or Microsoft Entra ID sign-in, and .bacpac backups.

limits.no-named-instances: Named instances are not supported. Connect to the instance’s TCP port.
limits.no-ntlm: NTLM is not supported. Sign in with a SQL Server login, Kerberos or Microsoft Entra ID.
limits.no-explain: There is no EXPLAIN or execution plan view for SQL Server.
limits.scripts-not-in-transaction: A script runs outside any transaction TablePro opens, as it does in SQL Server Management Studio, so statements that ran before an error stay applied.
limits.ios-tls-not-verified: On iPhone and iPad, TLS can be required, but the server certificate is not verified.

sqlite.tagline: Database files opened in place, on this Mac or on an SSH server, with loadable extensions.

limits.no-encryption: Encrypted databases, such as SQLCipher and SEE files, do not open. Decrypt the file first.
limits.no-primary-key-changes: A primary key cannot be added, removed or moved.
limits.ios-file-copied: On iPhone and iPad, a file you pick is copied into the app, and edits change that copy.
limits.extensions-local-file-only: Extensions load only for a file read on this Mac. A database opened on an SSH server cannot load them; a read-only copy of it can.
limits.attached-files-not-listed: A file you ATTACH in the editor can be queried, but it does not appear in the sidebar.

mongodb.tagline: A mongosh-style JavaScript shell, documents as Extended JSON, and Atlas clusters over SRV.

limits.no-gridfs-or-change-streams: GridFS and change streams are not supported.
limits.no-pipeline-builder: There is no visual aggregation pipeline builder. Write aggregate() in the shell.

redis.tagline: Redis commands, a key tree split on colons, TTLs, and Sentinel or Cluster connections.

limits.string-values-only: Only string values can be edited in the grid. Change lists, sets, hashes, sorted sets and streams with commands.
limits.no-pubsub: There is no pub/sub view. PUBLISH runs as a command, and nothing subscribes.
limits.key-tree-cap: The sidebar’s key tree loads at most {value} keys.
limits.filter-match-cap: A key filter stops after {value} matches.
limits.cluster-db0-only: A Cluster connection uses database 0, except on a Valkey cluster set up with more than one database.
limits.ios-query-tab-only: On iPhone and iPad, keys do not open in the table browser. Run commands in the Query tab.

mariadb.tagline: The MySQL driver with MariaDB’s sequences, virtual and persistent columns, and JSON columns.

limits.no-cloud-sql-proxy: Cloud SQL Auth Proxy is not offered for MariaDB. Reach a private server through an SSH tunnel.
limits.roles-listed-as-users: Users & Roles lists MariaDB roles as users. Create and grant roles with SQL in the editor.

tidb.tagline: TiDB and TiDB Cloud on the MySQL driver, with Stop sent as KILL TIDB QUERY.

limits.no-triggers-or-routines: No triggers, stored routines or events.
limits.no-dashboard-or-dump: No Server Dashboard and no Backup Dump. Export with TiDB’s Dumpling instead.
limits.structure-sync-same-engine: Compare & Sync writes structure scripts between TiDB databases only, not between TiDB and MySQL or MariaDB.

oceanbase.tagline: OceanBase tenants in MySQL mode, signed in as user@tenant, directly or through OBProxy.

limits.mysql-mode-only: Only MySQL-mode tenants connect. Oracle-mode tenants are refused.
limits.no-dashboard-or-dump: No Server Dashboard and no Backup Dump.
limits.structure-sync-same-engine: Compare & Sync writes structure scripts between OceanBase databases only, not between OceanBase and MySQL or MariaDB.

databend.tagline: Databend and Databend Cloud through Databend’s MySQL handler.

limits.no-keys-or-indexes: Databend has no indexes, primary keys or foreign keys, so a row edit matches on every column, and a save that would change more than one row is refused.
limits.no-url-scheme: No URL scheme opens a Databend connection. Create it in the connection form.
limits.not-on-ios: Not available on iPhone and iPad.

redshift.tagline: Amazon Redshift on the PostgreSQL driver, with DISTKEY and SORTKEY in the DDL.

limits.no-aws-iam: AWS IAM sign-in is not available for Redshift. Sign in as a database user.
limits.structure-read-only: The Structure tab is read-only. Run DDL in the editor.
limits.ios-synced-only: On iPhone and iPad, a Redshift connection opens only when it was synced or imported from a Mac.

cockroachdb.tagline: CockroachDB and CockroachDB Cloud over the PostgreSQL wire protocol.

limits.structure-read-only: The Structure tab is read-only. Run schema changes as SQL in the editor.
limits.no-dump-or-maintenance: No Backup Dump, Restore Dump or table maintenance. Use CockroachDB’s own BACKUP and RESTORE statements.

pglite.tagline: PGlite served by its socket server, as an ordinary PostgreSQL connection.

limits.needs-socket-server: PGlite has to be served by @electric-sql/pglite-socket, which you start yourself and keep running.
limits.single-client: The socket server accepts one client at a time.
limits.cancel-has-no-effect: Cancel has no effect: a query always runs to completion.

oracle.tagline: A pure-Swift driver with no Instant Client, PL/SQL scripts and DBMS_OUTPUT.

limits.no-wallet-os-auth-kerberos-ldap: Oracle wallets, OS authentication, Kerberos and LDAP are not supported. Connect with a service name or SID and a password.
limits.no-explain: There is no EXPLAIN or execution plan view for Oracle.
limits.no-users-roles: Users & Roles is not available. Manage accounts with CREATE USER and GRANT in the editor.
limits.no-packages: Packages are not listed in the sidebar. Standalone procedures and functions are.

clickhouse.tagline: ClickHouse over HTTP or HTTPS, with EXPLAIN variants, mutations and the Parts tab.

limits.http-only: Connections use ClickHouse’s HTTP interface. The native TCP protocol is not used.
limits.tls-off-by-default: TLS is off by default. Choose an SSL mode in the connection form to use HTTPS.
limits.no-foreign-keys-or-transactions: No foreign keys and no transactions.
limits.set-does-not-persist: A SET statement does not carry over to the next query.

duckdb.tagline: DuckDB files, Parquet, CSV and JSON files as views, and in-memory databases.

limits.one-writer-per-file: One process writes to a DuckDB file at a time, for as long as the connection is open.
limits.extensions-download-on-first-use: The driver includes the core functions, JSON, Parquet, ICU and autocomplete extensions. Others, such as httpfs, download from DuckDB the first time a query needs them.
limits.remote-quack-experimental: Remote connections over Quack are experimental.

cassandra.tagline: CQL with contact points, TLS and Amazon Keyspaces SigV4 sign-in.

limits.scalar-edits-only: Only scalar columns can be edited in the grid. Collections, tuples, user-defined types and durations need an UPDATE in the editor.
limits.no-consistency-level: There is no consistency-level setting. Statements run at the driver’s default, LOCAL_ONE.
limits.no-astra-bundle: DataStax Astra DB does not connect, because its secure connect bundle cannot be loaded.
limits.no-views-or-types-in-sidebar: Materialized views and user-defined types are not listed in the sidebar.

scylladb.tagline: ScyllaDB through the Cassandra driver, with the same CQL workflow.

dynamodb.tagline: PartiQL and DynamoDB API JSON, with a planner that picks Query or Scan from your filters and reports the read capacity each read consumed.

limits.one-account-and-region: Each connection covers one AWS account in one region.
limits.no-dax-or-truncate: DAX endpoints are not supported, and Truncate is not offered.

bigquery.tagline: GoogleSQL with Max Bytes Billed and a Dry Run cost estimate before a query runs.

limits.structure-read-only: The Structure tab is read-only. Run DDL in the editor.

snowflake.tagline: Key pair, browser SSO, OAuth or a password with a passcode, with warehouse and role in Session Context.

limits.duo-passcode-only: Duo works with a passcode only. Push approval is not supported.

cloudflare-d1.tagline: Every D1 database in a Cloudflare account, reached over the D1 HTTP API.

limits.no-session-state-or-transactions: Each statement is a separate HTTP request: no session state carries over, and transactions are not supported.

turso.tagline: Remote Turso databases over HTTP with a token, through the libSQL driver.

limits.no-database-switching-or-branches: Each connection is one database. Switching databases and branches are not supported.
limits.no-embedded-replicas: Embedded replicas are not supported: a local file opens on its own and does not sync.

libsql.tagline: libSQL files on this Mac, or sqld servers over HTTP.

limits.dump-local-file-only: Backup Dump works for a local libSQL file only, not for a remote database.

elasticsearch.tagline: A Query DSL console, indices as tables, and document edits by _id.

limits.aliases-not-listed: Aliases and data streams are not listed in the sidebar. Address them by name in the console.

etcd.tagline: A subset of etcdctl over the v3 JSON gateway: keys under a prefix, leases and members.

limits.json-gateway-only: Connections use the v3 JSON gateway, not gRPC.
limits.watch-collects-until-timeout: watch collects events until its timeout, then shows them as rows.

kafka.tagline: Consume and produce with KafkaQL, with topics, partitions and consumer-group lag.

limits.no-schema-registry: Schema Registry is not read, so Avro and Protobuf values show as raw bytes.
limits.no-topic-create-or-offset-reset: Creating topics, editing topic configuration and resetting consumer-group offsets are not supported.

surrealdb.tagline: SurrealQL over HTTP RPC, with root, namespace, database, record or token sign-in.

limits.no-syntax-highlighting: SurrealQL is not syntax-highlighted in the editor.
limits.no-live-queries: Live queries are not supported. Rerun a query to see new records.

teradata.tagline: TD2 or TDNEGO sign-in, with procedures and macros listed in the sidebar.

limits.ldap-kerberos-jwt-refused: LDAP, Kerberos and JWT sign-in are refused. Use TD2 or TDNEGO.
limits.foreign-keys-not-listed: Foreign keys are not listed. Read them from the table’s DDL.

trino.tagline: Cross-catalog SQL over Trino’s REST API, signed in with a password or a JWT.

limits.no-kerberos-or-oauth: Kerberos and OAuth sign-in are not supported.

beancount.tagline: A Beancount ledger read as SQL tables, plus BQL queries.

limits.projected-tables: TablePro reads the ledger into {value} read-only SQL tables when it opens. Nothing is written back to the ledger.
limits.needs-ledger-tool: Needs rledger or Python beancount installed on this Mac.

spanner.tagline: GoogleSQL or PostgreSQL dialect, detected on connect, and the Spanner emulator.

limits.structure-read-only: The Structure tab is read-only. Change a table with ALTER TABLE in the editor.

typesense.tagline: A REST request console, collections as tables, and a metrics dashboard.

limits.api-keys-as-users: Typesense has no user accounts, so API keys are listed where other engines list users.

weaviate.tagline: Collections as tables, read with GraphQL and written over REST.

limits.graphql-reads-rest-writes: GraphQL only reads. Browsing and row edits go through Weaviate’s REST endpoints.

cloudflare-r2-sql.tagline: Read-only SQL over Iceberg tables stored in Cloudflare R2.

limits.rows-per-query: A query returns at most {value} rows.
limits.billed-per-scan: Cloudflare bills R2 SQL by the data each query scans.

dameng.tagline: Dameng DM8 over its native protocol, with EXPLAIN plans and SSH tunnels.

limits.no-tls: TLS is not supported. Reach a server outside a private network through an SSH tunnel.

sap-hana.tagline: SAP HANA Cloud, HANA 2.0 and HANA Express, with structure shown read-only.

limits.no-tunnels: SSH tunnels, SOCKS proxies, Cloudflare tunnels and tunnel commands are not supported.
limits.unsupported-auth-methods: X.509 certificate, JWT, SAML, Kerberos and LDAP logons are not supported. Sign in as a database user with a password.
